digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Monday, October 26 has four live meetings, two protected work blocks, eight relevant carry-overs, and two urgent priorities. The day turns on setting the Amazon Connect recovery and Denver decision gate, locking Sprint 21 around its 95-point capacity, using the Contigo touchpoint to close the remaining service and ownership gaps, and sending any ELT blockers before noon while morning escalation coverage is limited. Repository completion state is five days old, so carry-over reflects the latest repository-backed record and may not include very recent dashboard actions.

items.label: Set the Amazon Connect recovery and Denver go-live gate
items.detail: A First Fire resource is due to begin the Lambda workaround today. Use the 10:30 AM standup to confirm the owner and timing, what testing resumes afterward, whether the Salesforce-alias character issue affects user setup, and the evidence required for Denver's go/no-go decision.

items.label: Lock the Sprint 21 scope against the 95-point capacity
items.detail: Friday's follow-up set Sprint 21 at 95 points and noted that Send Letters Queue 2.0 consumes about 40% of capacity. Confirm the final Monday-ready story list, remaining compliance tradeoffs, and explicit owners for anything blocked or unestimated.

items.label: Close the MHE expansion's remaining capture and ownership gaps
items.detail: Florida and Texas clients are currently going to Roots, screening covers 90-day and no-due-date RFEs, and shorter deadlines are being supplemented through Refile. Confirm the answer on screening immediately after declaration, review the provider-and-state document due today, and name the remaining IT owner and decision dates.

items.label: Review Astrid Ortega's project-access requests
items.detail: The batch spans Litify task sets, automations, templates, case types, and related project records. Validate the intended role and business need, then process the requests consistently as one permission decision.

items.label: Resolve the overdue harassment-prevention training
items.detail: Rippling again lists the Dominican Republic EOR course as overdue since December 9, 2025. Complete it or confirm with HR why the assignment remains open.

items.label: Decide David Molano's file-access request
items.detail: Approve or decline access to 'SKILL (2) 2.md' after confirming the file's purpose and the permission level David needs.

items.label: Clarify the Denial and RFE categorization intake
items.detail: Confirm whether the request is a controlled list of reasons, whether it warrants project delivery, and who owns the next step so the intake can be routed cleanly.

items.label: Complete the LeadUp growth-mindset follow-up survey
items.detail: The Module 3 follow-up is still awaiting Jean's response. Use a low-context window today or assign a firm completion time.

items.label: 8:00 AM - Approve timecards and prepare the week
items.detail: Use the opening hour to clear timecards, identify any ELT blockers due before noon, and rank the decisions that must move today.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Amazon Connect daily standup
items.detail: Confirm the Lambda workaround start, testing restart criteria, user-setup blockers, and the decision path for Denver. Keep the broader product-fit and deployment-capacity risk visible.

items.label: 11:30 AM - Contigo Plan touchpoint
items.detail: The project is on track for a November 6 go/no-go. Use Evan's input to close the workflow, cost, capacity, referral-handoff, and ownership gaps behind that decision.

items.label: Noon - Protected work block
items.detail: Convert the morning meetings into named owners and dates, then send any ELT blockers while the escalation window is still useful.

items.label: 2:00 PM - BD portfolio review
items.detail: Review active status, new intake, and the few risks that need a priority or owner decision; keep routine updates out of the decision queue.

items.label: 3:00 PM - Maria and Jean 1:1
items.detail: Carry forward only unresolved portfolio roadblocks and next-owner choices from the 2:00 PM review.

items.label: Send Monday's ELT blockers before noon
items.detail: The escalation channel asked for blockers today, and morning coverage is limited. Consolidate only issues that need leadership intervention and route Nadia's escalations through the relevant project PM.

items.label: Turn the Contigo touchpoint into a go/no-go decision plan
items.detail: The re-scoped service now covers locating a detained client, attorney consultation, case-packet preparation, and referral handoff, with a November 6 decision date. Leave today's meeting with owners, capacity assumptions, unresolved costs, and a short path to decision.

items.label: Submit the team's work-schedule patterns to HR
items.detail: HR needs each unique schedule pattern expressed in Eastern time by Friday, October 30. Confirm the team's patterns and complete the survey before the deadline.

items.label: Clarify timing for the PMO portfolio cleanup
items.detail: A teammate asked whether unlinking three projects is required today and flagged limited capacity. Confirm the actual deadline or explicitly defer the cleanup so it does not compete blindly with higher-priority work.

items.label: Jhara is out through November 2
items.detail: Her calendar shows an all-day out-of-office block through the start of November 3. Adjust Contigo follow-ups and tomorrow's overlapping 1:1 accordingly.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Jhara 1:1 and Amazon Connect standup conflict
items.detail: Jhara's out-of-office block makes the 1:1 unlikely to proceed as planned. Confirm the cancellation or replacement and keep the Amazon Connect recovery check covered.

items.label: 11:00 AM to noon - Slides, CM CoE touchpoint, then protected work
items.detail: Use the slide block to prepare the shortest decision narrative, carry only unresolved CM CoE overlap issues into the touchpoint, and preserve the noon hour for follow-through.

items.label: 2:00 PM to 4:30 PM - Leadership and portfolio sequence
items.detail: EPMO leadership flows into Nicolas's 1:1 and the CSC portfolio review. Prepare one risk-and-owner narrative that can travel across the three sessions without reopening settled questions.
